//: Node-side coverage pass. Wraps `npm test`, so it captures every Node
process the suites spawn (node --test for the wrapper, the Playwright
drivers for serve.mjs + examples.js, and any cli.mjs subprocess a future
test spawns: c8 sets NODE_V8_COVERAGE and children inherit it).
INCLUDE is the set of first-party files reachable from Node. `all: true`
forces them into the report at 0% even when no test loaded them yet, so a
missing CLI test shows up as a gap instead of vanishing.
Browser-only modules (web/ui.js, web/repl.js, web/render-client.js) are
NOT listed here: they never run in Node. They are measured in the browser
via Playwright V8 coverage and merged in by tools/coverage. web/examples.js
is listed because the REPL driver imports it in Node; it is ALSO measured
in the browser and the two maps merge (both go through v8-to-istanbul).
web/highlight.js and web/sdl-validate.js are likewise listed: they are pure,
DOM-free modules covered to 100% by the Node unit tests, and ALSO imported by
web/ui.js in the browser, so the two maps merge the same way examples.js does.
EXCLUDE, why each is not first-party / not measured here:
web/coi-serviceworker.js : vendored third-party (MIT, pinned).
dist/povray.mjs, dist/povray.wasm : emscripten-generated runtime.
dist/index.d.ts : type declaration, not executable.
(dist/index.js IS measured: it is the built image of wrapper/src/index.ts;
tsc emits no sourcemap, so the wrapper is measured against dist/index.js
directly, per the architecture decision.)
web/ui.js, web/repl.js, web/render-client.js : browser-only, measured via
Playwright and merged separately (listed here only to keep the Node pass
from emitting a divergent 0% map that would fight the browser map).
*.test.mjs, test/fixtures/**, tools/**, *.config.* : test + tooling
scaffolding (test/browser/serve.mjs is first-party and IS measured, so
the exclude targets *.test.mjs specifically, never a blanket test/**).
node_modules/**, coverage/**, wrapper/** : deps, reports, TS source.
